Store in airtight containers. Profile Hexamidine isetionate has antibacterial and antifungal properties and is available in preparations for the local treatment of minor infections. Acanthamoeba keratitis. Hexamidine was suggested1 as a possible alternative to propamidine for the treatment of Acan- thamoeba keratitis (p.822) due to the poor cysticidal activity, chronic conjunctival infection, and resistance of some Acan- thamoeba strains seen with propamidine.1,2 Cures have been re- ported with 0.1% hexamidine used either as monotherapy2,3 or with polihexanide.2 1. Perrine D, et al. Amoebicidal efficiencies of various diamidines against two strains of Acanthamoeba polyphaga. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 1995; 39: 339–42.
